title: Dedicated capacity intake — SLA archetype interviewer & routing checklist
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Purpose: create a repeatable interviewer-style checklist and lightweight scoring rubric for incoming enterprise dedicated capacity requests. The goal is to (1) capture consistent signals about SLA latency/availability needs, steady-state reserved throughput, burst pattern tolerances, and GPU-class fit; (2) provide deterministic routing guidance to Dedicated, Dedicated+Burst, or Private onboarding paths; and (3) surface high-risk inputs (preemption intolerance, regulatory constraints, extremely low-latency requirements) to the concierge and sales teams. This ticket delivers the artifact (interview checklist + scoring spreadsheet + routing decision matrix) and a small training doc for Concierge.
acceptance_criteria: Interviewer checklist document drafted with at least 18 canonical questions covering traffic shape, latency SLOs, availability SLOs, max sustained tokens/s, expected burst ratio, tolerance for quantization/compression, and data residency needs
Scoring rubric implemented: numeric scores map to routing lanes (Self-serve Dedicated, Dedicated Concierge, Private/VPC) with cutoffs documented
Decision matrix implemented which recommends GPU class (A100-40, A100-80, H100, T4) based on perf/latency/throughput profile and explains cost tradeoffs
Example intake: three anonymized customer interviews converted to completed checklists and routed according to the matrix
Constrained scenarios flagged: anything with <10ms p95 or >100k tokens/sec sustained is escalated to ENG for feasibility
Training note and one-page play for Concierge published in Drive; stakeholders (Sales, Solutions, ENG) have reviewed and signed off.

decision_log: 2026-03-11 Decision: Use a 0-10 numeric score per question. Aggregate score thresholds: 0-30 -> Self-serve Dedicated; 31-60 -> Concierge Dedicated; 61+ or regulatory flag -> Private/VPC. Rationale: balances volatility with operational cost and concierge effort.
2026-03-12 Decision: Treat 'preemption intolerant' as immediate concierge escalation. Rationale: requires node-isolation and longer-term reservation planning.

2026-03-13 Decision: GPU recommendation heuristic will prefer H100 for p95 latency <50ms, A100-80 for sustained high throughput >10k tokens/s, T4 for low-cost inference with latency >200ms. Documented cost multipliers in notes.
owner_notes: Next steps: run 4 pilot interviews this week (assigned customers: ACME-adtech, NxHealth-PoC) and convert to completed checklists. After pilots, present final checklist + routing matrix at Product Review (2026-03-24). Coordinate with ENG to create runbook for 'feasibility' escalations.
risk_summary: Main risk is customer inputs that are poorly specified (customers provide latency SLAs but no traffic shape), which can lead to misrouting. Mitigation: include mandatory proxy conversion table and require samples of typical payloads and prompt sets for Concierge review.
